Title: NavMenu Component
Summary: Sidebar navigation menu with responsive toggle and NavLink routing.
Content:
## NavMenu.razor **Path:** `Components/Layout/NavMenu.razor` **Type:** Shared component (no `@page` directive) ### Purpose Renders the application's sidebar navigation menu with responsive toggle behavior. ### Structure ```razor
MyBlazorApp
Home
Counter
Weather
``` ### Navigation Links | Route | Label | Match Behavior | |-------|-------|----------------| | `/` | Home | `NavLinkMatch.All` — active only on exact root match | | `/counter` | Counter | Default — active on prefix match | | `/weather` | Weather | Default — active on prefix match | ### Accessibility - `aria-hidden="true"` on icon spans prevents screen readers from announcing decorative icons. - `title="Navigation menu"` on the toggle checkbox provides a tooltip for the menu button. ### Responsive Behavior - The `.navbar-toggler` checkbox controls the visibility of `.nav-scrollable` via CSS. - On small screens, the menu is collapsed; clicking the toggle expands it. - The `onclick` handler on `.nav-scrollable` auto-closes the menu when a link is tapped on mobile. ### CSS Scoped styles in `NavMenu.razor.css` define the dark navbar theme, icon backgrounds, and responsive breakpoints. ### Notes - The `bi-*-nav-menu` classes are custom CSS that inject Bootstrap Icons as background images. - This component is rendered inside `MainLayout.razor`'s `.sidebar` div.
